fieldMarks: Drake: mostly white body, black back and iridescent green head.
Red bill, thick at the base and narrowing to the tip.
Hen: gray body with a bright rusty head and a sharply defined white throat.
behavior: Dives and swims underwater, kicking both feet together; hunts mostly by sight.
Eats mainly fish, also mussels, shrimp and salamanders.
Migrates late in fall and early in spring; males winter farther north than females and young.
habitat: Clear rivers and lakes in forested country in summer; lakes, large rivers and occasionally coastal bays in winter. Mainly fresh water.
range: Breeds across Alaska and Canada and occurs through most of the continental US in suitable habitat.

lookalikes.name: Red-breasted merganser
lookalikes.howToTell: Hens are similar; compare the common merganser hen's sharply defined white throat.

lookalikes.name: Mallard
lookalikes.howToTell: Other green-headed ducks such as the mallard have a different body pattern and shape.
